papers.title: LATERN: Test-Time Context-Aware Explainable Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Mitchell Piehl, Muchao Ye
papers.affiliations: The University of Iowa, Iowa City IA 52245, USA
papers.intro: LATERN是一个在测试阶段为冻结的视觉语言模型引入长程上下文感知的、可解释的视频异常检测框架，通过上下文感知异常评分（CEA）和递归证据聚合（REA）将VAD重构为时间证据聚合过程，生成时间连贯且语义可信的事件级异常检测分数与解释。

papers.title: Multi-proposal Collaboration and Multi-task Training for Weakly-supervised Video Moment Retrieval
papers.authors: Bolin Zhang, Chao Yang, Bin Jiang, Takahiro Komamizu, Ichiro Ide
papers.tags: video search, video segmentation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: 湖南大学计算机科学与电子工程学院；宁波大学电子工程与计算机科学学院；名古屋大学数学与数据科学中心；名古屋大学信息学研究生院
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种名为MCMT（Multi-proposal Collaboration and Multi-task Training）的弱监督视频时刻检索方法，通过多高斯掩码提案协作生成高质量正样本掩码，并引入前向与逆向双掩码查询重建任务来增强模型训练的约束力和稳定性。

papers.title: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
papers.authors: Weimin Xiong, Shuhao Gu, Bowen Ye, Zihao Yue, Lei Li, Feifan Song, Sujian Li, Hao Tian
papers.affiliations: 北京大学、小米、中国人民大学、香港大学
papers.intro: 提出Video2GUI，一个全自动框架，从无标注互联网视频中提取高质量GUI交互轨迹，构建了包含12.7M轨迹、覆盖1500+应用/网站的WildGUI数据集，预训练Qwen2.5-VL和Mimo-VL后，在多个GUI接地和智能体基准上获得5-20%的一致性提升，匹配或超越当时最先进水平。

papers.title: CoReDiT: Spatial Coherence-Guided Token Pruning and Reconstruction for Efficient Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Zhuojin Li, Hsin-Pai Cheng, Hong Cai, Shizhong Han, Fatih Porikli
papers.intro: CoReDiT提出一种基于空间一致性的结构化令牌剪枝框架，通过线性时间计算一致性分数选择冗余令牌并跳过其自注意力计算，再由邻近保留令牌重建其输出，并配合渐进式块自适应剪枝调度，显著降低DiT计算成本。

papers.title: TeDiO: Temporal Diagonal Optimization for Training-Free Coherent Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Nurislam Tursynbek, Zhiqiang Lao, Heather Yu, Gedas Bertasius, Marc Niethammer
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, vision transformer, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: UNC Chapel Hill, Futurewei Technologies Inc, UCSD
papers.intro: 论文提出TeDiO，一种无需训练的推理时优化方法，通过正则化扩散Transformer内部时间自注意力图的对角线平滑性来增强视频运动稳定性，无需修改模型权重、重训练或使用外部监督。

papers.title: PanoPlane: Plane-Aware Panoramic Completion for Sparse-View Indoor 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Adil Qureshi, Dongki Jung, Jaehoon Choi, Dinesh Manocha
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.intro: PanoPlane提出一种全景完成+布局锚定注意力引导的方法，利用预训练扩散模型在推理时无训练地生成几何一致的全景图像，从而为稀疏视图室内3D高斯泼溅提供强监督，实现最先进的稀疏视图新视角合成质量。

papers.title: SToRe3D: Sparse Token Relevance in ViTs for Efficient Multi-View 3D Object Detection
papers.authors: Sandro Papais, Lezhou Feng, Charles Cossette, Lingting Ge
papers.tags: object detection, autonomous driving, vision transformer, BEV perception
papers.affiliations: Sandro Papais - University of Toronto Lezhou Feng - Zoox Inc. Charles Cossette - Zoox Inc. Lingting Ge - Zoox Inc.
papers.intro: SToRe3D提出一个规划对齐的联合稀疏框架，通过轻量级2D-3D相关性头同时选择图像token和三维目标query，并使用存储-重新激活缓冲区实现激进稀疏下的特征恢复，在nuScenes上达到最高3倍加速且精度损失微小。

papers.title: CurveBench: A Benchmark for Exact Topological Reasoning over Nested Jordan Curves
papers.authors: Amirreza Mohseni, Mona Mohammadi, Morteza Saghafian, Naser Talebizadeh Sardari
papers.affiliations: Maastricht University, Cornell University, TU Wien, Pennsylvania State University
papers.intro: 提出 CurveBench——一个用于评估视觉语言模型从互不相交 Jordan 曲线图像中精确恢复嵌套包含树（根化树）能力的基准，并通过 RLVR 风格的强化学习微调开源 VLM 显著提升其性能，但最难的测试子集仍远未解决。

papers.title: Bad Seeing or Bad Thinking? Rewarding Perception for Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.authors: Haozhe Wang, Qixin Xu, Changpeng Wang, Taofeng Xue, Chong Peng, Wenhu Chen, Fangzhen Lin
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), Tsinghua University, Zhejiang University, Meituan, China, University of Waterloo
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的模态感知信用分配机制（MoCA），通过强制将VLM生成过程解耦为感知和推理步骤，并引入“盲眼推理”代理和结构化语言验证来分别奖励感知质量和最终回答，从而有效缓解了感知与推理的“跷跷板效应”。

papers.title: Evolving Layer-Specific Scalar Functions for Hardware-Aware Transformer Adaptation
papers.authors: Kieran Carrigg, Sigur de Vries, Amirhossein Sadough, Marcel van Gerven
papers.tags: image classification, vision transformer, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition, and Behaviour
papers.intro: 本文提出一个基于遗传编程的框架，为预训练ViT逐层进化异质标量函数替代LayerNorm，并结合后训练重对齐策略，在仅20个epoch内恢复84.25% ImageNet Top-1准确率，有效消除了全局归约瓶颈，改善了硬件部署效率。

papers.title: PVRF: All-in-one Adverse Weather Removal via Prior-modulated and Velocity-constrained Rectified Flow
papers.authors: Wei Dong, Han Zhou, Terry Ji, Guanhua Zhao, Shahab Asoodeh, Yulun Zhang, Guangtao Zhai, Jun Chen, Xiaohong Liu
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: McMaster University (Wei Dong, Han Zhou, Terry Ji, Guanhua Zhao, Shahab Asoodeh, Jun Chen); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Yulun Zhang, Guangtao Zhai, Xiaohong Liu)
papers.intro: 提出PVRF，一个统一框架，通过零样本软天气感知（来自冻结VLM）引导的失真恢复网络和速度约束的修正流模型，同时提升保真度和感知质量，实现对所有类型恶劣天气（包括混合退化）的鲁棒去除。

papers.title: Masked Autoencoders with Limited Data: Does It Work? A Fine-Grained Bioacoustics Case Study
papers.authors: Wuao Liu, Mustafa Chasmai, Subhransu Maji, Grant Van Horn
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了掩码自编码器（MAE）在中等规模、弱标注的细粒度生物声学数据集（iNatSounds）上的预训练效果，发现预训练数据规模远比目标设计或额外领域特化预训练更重要，且领域特化继续预训练或选择性数据筛选带来的收益有限甚至为负。

papers.title: Unified Pix Token And Word Token Generative Language Model
papers.authors: Haun Leung, ZiNan Wang
papers.intro: 本文提出一种统一像素令牌（pix token）和文字令牌（word token）的生成式语言模型，通过为每个像素赋予独立可调的token embedding、颜色折叠、全局条件注意力近似和图像无监督预训练，实现了无需ViT编码器的视觉与语言统一生成。

papers.title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture
papers.authors: Haiwen Diao, Penghao Wu, Hanming Deng, Jiahao Wang, Shihao Bai, Silei Wu, Weichen Fan, Wenjie Ye, Wenwen Tong, Xiangyu Fan, Yan Li, Yubo Wang, Zhijie Cao, Zhiqian Lin, Zhitao Yang, Zhongang Cai, Yuwei Niu, Yue Zhu, Bo Liu, Chengguang Lv, Haojia Yu, Haozhe Xie, Hongli Wang, Jianan Fan, Jiaqi Li, Jiefan Lu, Jingcheng Ni, Junxiang Xu, Kaihuan Liang, Lianqiang Shi, Linjun Dai, Linyan Wang, Oscar Qian, Peng Gao, Pengfei Liu, Qingping Sun, Rui Shen, Ruisi Wang, Shengnan Ma, Shuang Yang, Siyi Xie, Siying Li, Tianbo Zhong, Xiangli Kong, Xuanke Shi, Yang Gao, Yongqiang Yao, Yves Wang, Zhengqi Bai, Zhengyu Lin, Zixin Yin, Wenxiu Sun, Ruihao Gong, Quan Wang, Lewei Lu, Lei Yang, Ziwei Liu, Dahua Lin
papers.affiliations: 未明确（论文正文第一页未提供作者机构信息）
papers.intro: SenseNova-U1基于NEO-unify架构，通过近无损视觉接口、原生端到端统一建模和原生混合物变换器（MoT）架构，首次实现无需预训练视觉编码器或VAE的理解-生成一体化多模态模型，在两个变体上达到甚至超越顶尖理解专用模型，同时具备强大的任意到图像合成、图文交错生成能力，并初步展现视觉-语言…

papers.title: CausalCine: Real-Time Autoregressive Generation for Multi-Shot Video Narratives
papers.authors: Yihao Meng, Zichen Liu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Ka Leong Cheng, Yue Yu, Hanlin Wang, Haobo Li, Jiapeng Zhu, Yanhong Zeng, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Qifeng Chen, Huamin Qu
papers.intro: CausalCine是一个交互式自回归框架，通过先在原生多镜头序列上训练因果基模型、引入内容感知记忆路由（CAMR）以及蒸馏为少步生成器，实现了实时、流式的多镜头视频生成，支持在线提示更新和跨镜头一致性。

papers.title: Revisiting Photometric Ambiguity for Accurate Gaussian-Splatting Surface Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jiahe Li, Jiawei Zhang, Xiao Bai, Jin Zheng, Xiaohan Yu, Lin Gu, Gim Hee Lee
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Beihang University, National University of Singapore, Macquarie University, Tohoku University
papers.intro: 本文提出AmbiSuR框架，通过揭示Gaussian Splatting中的两种内建原始级光度歧义并引入消歧策略，同时利用球谐系数作为免费歧义自指示器以引导先验正则化，从而在多种挑战场景下实现高精度的表面重建。

papers.title: Elastic Attention Cores for Scalable Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Alan Z. Song, Yinjie Chen, Mu Nan, Rui Zhang, Jiahang Cao, Weijian Mai, Muquan Yu, Hossein Adeli, Deva Ramanan, Michael J. Tarr, Andrew F. Luo
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, University of Hong Kong, Columbia University
papers.intro: 提出VECA（Visual Elastic Core Attention）架构，用核心-外围（core-periphery）结构的线性时间注意力替代全自注意力，并通过嵌套训练实现弹性计算-精度权衡，在不直接依赖补丁间交互的前提下达到与前沿视觉基础模型竞争的性能。

papers.title: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Xuhao Hu, Xi Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Kyle Qiao, Jingyi Yang, Xuanjing Huang, Jing Shao, Ming Yan, Jieping Ye
papers.tags: gui, multimodal learning, visual grounding, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group（Xuhao Hu, Xi Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Kyle Qiao, Ming Yan, Jieping Ye）；Fudan University（Xuhao Hu, Jingyi Yang, Xuanjing Huang）；Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory（Jing Shao）
papers.intro: 本文提出ToolCUA，一种端到端代理，通过可扩展的交错GUI-工具轨迹合成和两阶段训练（工具引导的GUI监督与强化学习 + 在线强化学习）来学习最优GUI-工具路径选择，在OSWorld-MCP基准上达到新最优性能。

papers.title: OmniNFT: Modality-wise Omni Diffusion Reinforcement for Joint Audio-Video Generation
papers.authors: Guohui Zhang, XiaoXiao Ma, Jie Huang, Hang Xu, Hu Yu, Siming Fu, Yuming Li, Zeyue Xue, Lin Song, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan, Feng Zhao
papers.tags: video generation, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: 未明确（多个机构：University of Science and Technology of China, Peking University, JD Explore Academy，但未在基本信息字段中明确列出，需在作者机构部分详细说明）
papers.intro: 提出OmniNFT，一种模态感知的在线扩散强化学习框架，通过模态级优势路由、层级梯度手术和区域级损失重加权，解决联合音频-视频生成中多目标优化不一致、梯度失衡和均匀信用分配问题，在JavisBench和VBench上显著提升感知质量、跨模态对齐和音视频同步。

papers.title: FuTCR: Future-Targeted Contrast and Repulsion for Continual Panoptic Segmentation
papers.authors: Nicholas Ikechukwu, Keanu Nichols, Deepti Ghadiyaram, Bryan A. Plummer
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Mask Generation, object detection
papers.intro: FuTCR 提出一种未来目标对比与排斥框架，通过利用模型自身预测发现未来类区域，并对其施加像素-区域对比学习和已知类排斥损失，在持续全景分割中显著提升新类性能并保持旧类性能。
